responses.text: {Lucky 38 re-lit}The great tower of the enemy city blazes with light. What does it mean?
{Wild Child 1}Sometimes friend, sometimes foe. No one knows what to make of you.
{Wild Child 2}I've heard stories about you. No one knows what you'll do next.
{Wild Child 3}I'm not looking for trouble. You can ignore me.
{apologetic - got in someone's way}Excuse me.
{Random}My feet are killing me.
{low voice}It's said that you were responsible for Caesar's death.
{Brotherhood destroyed}The Legionaries are pleased - an enemy called the Brotherhood of Steel is dead.
{Great Khans attack everyone at Dam}The Great Khans tribe went mad. During the battle at the Dam, they attacked both the Legion and the NCR.
{Camp Forlorn Hope destroyed}The Legion has won a great victory over the NCR at a place called Forlorn Hope.
{Mr. House Unplugged/Killed}I've heard that a great enemy of the Legion was assassinated in New Vegas.
{Caesar cured}Caesar was ill, but now he lives.
{Companion Reaction - Rex}How disgusting. You can see that strange mechanical mongrel's brain.
{Companion Reaction - Raul}Ugh. One of the burned people walks in our camp.
{Companion Reaction - ED-E}What a strange floating robot. Is it useful for anything?
{Companion Reaction - Lily}What is that thing? I've never seen a blue mutant.
{Rumors of Legion Veterans}I overheard some of the Legionaries say that more veterans from the eastern campaigns will be summoned to the Fort.
{Mr. House victory}The leader of New Vegas and his army of robots has defeated both the NCR and the Legion. What will happen now?
{NCR victory}There's talk that many of the ranking Legionaries will be beheaded for allowing the NCR to defeat the Legion yet again.
{Legion Veterans arriving}A great battle is coming. Many veterans of the Legion have begun arriving from the east.
{Caesar dead}There are many rumors about who'll lead the Legion now that Caesar is dead.
{Player completed Securitron bunker mission}That was quite an explosion a while ago. We felt the ground shake!
{Great Khans unaltered/helping Caesar}I've heard rumors that one of the tribes west of the river may join the Legion.
{Random}The work never ends...
{Random}So many tasks to attend to...
{Random}I need to rest.
{Thug 3}It's best if I'm not seen talking to you.
{Thug 2}Be careful, or you'll end up being crucified.
{Thug 1}The Legionaries grumble about you. Be careful.
{Hated 3}The Legionaries want to kill you. Please don't get me involved.
{Hated 2}The Legion hates you. Why do you come here?
{Hated 1}Please - I'll be in trouble if the Legionaries see you speaking to me.
{Mixed 3}You're trouble, I can tell.
{Mixed 2}Be careful - the Legionaries aren't sure they can trust you.
{Mixed 1}You're not quite an enemy, nor are you a friend.
{Rascal 3}Your favor with the Legion grows, I've heard.
{Rascal 2}Some of the Legionaries talk about you with growing respect.
{Rascal 1}I'm honored to serve.
{Liked 3}Someone as important as you noticing me? I'm flattered.
{Liked 2}The Legionaries speak highly of you. I'm not worthy of your attention.
{Liked 1}It's an honor to be noticed by one so favored by the Legion.
{Random}You're a woman, and yet you wander free?{sound of contemplation, "hmm," or similar}
{confused - never had anyone surrender}Huh. I guess it's all right, then.
I'm sorry! I'm sorry!
I'm not a threat to anyone!
What did I do wrong?
Please, no more!
I'm no Legionary, but I'll kill you all the same!
I'll take you down with me!
You pushed me too far!
I'll kill you!
I'm just slave! I'm not worth it!
I don't want to die!
Mercy!
